context.transcript:
This is our final preparation meeting before the Carsonville Street Fair this weekend.
Remember, this is a huge opportunity for us at Marco Kitchen Supplies.
Attendees will have the chance to get hands-on experience with our newest small appliances and cooking utensils.
I need all of you to arrive by 9 a.m. to set up our tables and displays.
The Town Council told me that parking for the fair is always difficult.
The public will be able to park in the municipal garages close to Mercer Square and on the riverfront, but we'll need to park in the lot near Spruce Street.
Happily, it's a short walk to the fair site.
context.transcript_translation:
这是我们在本周末卡森维尔街市集前的最后一次准备会议。
请记住，这对我们马可厨房用品公司来说是一个巨大的机会。
与会者将有机会使用我们最新的小型电器和烹饪用具进行实践体验。
我需要你们所有人都在早上 9 点前到达，以便布置我们的桌子和展品。
镇议会告诉我，为这个市集停车总是很困难的。
公众可以在靠近默瑟广场和河滨的市政车库停车，但我们需要在斯普鲁斯街附近的停车场停车。
幸运的是，到市集地点步行很近。
